ServerAddress.title: Casama server
ServerAddress.description: The Casama server people sign in to, for example https://casama.example.com. Leave unset for Casama Cloud.

ActDisabled.title: Don't let bots use this browser
ActDisabled.description: When true, bots can't open or act on pages in this browser. Asking about pages still works.

BlockedSites.title: Sites bots may never act on
BlockedSites.description: Host names such as example.com (includes subdomains) or *.example.com (only subdomains).

AllowedSites.title: Sites bots may act on without asking
AllowedSites.description: Host names such as wiki.example.com. Banking, health, password manager and government ID sites still ask.

ExtensionDisabled.title: Turn Casama for Chrome off
ExtensionDisabled.description: When true, the extension does nothing except say it's turned off by your administrator.
